headline: Finance Ministry Details Support Measures for Fuel and 120 Installments
summary: The ministry announced measures to ease the burden on households and businesses. They include a higher diesel fuel subsidy and an expanded framework for settling overdue debts in 120 instalments.
why: Fuel subsidies and debt-settlement schemes affect household and business cash flow, and they are a direct fiscal lever of the Greek state.
